stdout:
powResponseAccept_density : ∀ (bits : ℕ), uniformProb (PoWResponse bits) powResponseAccept = 1 / 2 ^ bits
@powAttempt_factor : ∀ {bits : ℕ} {C : Type} [inst : Fintype C] (bad : C → Prop),
  (uniformProb (PoWResponse bits × C) fun x => powResponseAccept x.1 ∧ bad x.2) = uniformProb C bad / 2 ^ bits
@powGrindingWin_le : ∀ {bits work : ℕ} {C : Type} [inst : Fintype C]
  (bad : (i : Fin work) → ({ j // j ≠ i } → PoWAttempt bits C) → C → Prop) {epsilon : ℝ},
  0 ≤ epsilon →
    (∀ (i : Fin work) (rest : { j // j ≠ i } → PoWAttempt bits C), uniformProb C (bad i rest) ≤ epsilon) →
      uniformProb (Fin work → PoWAttempt bits C) (powGrindingWin bad) ≤ ↑work * epsilon / 2 ^ bits
powGrindingWin_le_grindingTermPoW : ∀ (P : PoWSoundnessParams) {C : Type} [inst : Fintype C]
  (bad : (i : Fin (P.queries + P.depth)) → ({ j // j ≠ i } → PoWAttempt P.powBits C) → C → Prop),
  (∀ (i : Fin (P.queries + P.depth)) (rest : { j // j ≠ i } → PoWAttempt P.powBits C),
      uniformProb C (bad i rest) ≤ ↑P.depth * (errStarUD P.toSoundnessParams + 1 / ↑P.fieldCard)) →
    uniformProb (Fin (P.queries + P.depth) → PoWAttempt P.powBits C) (powGrindingWin bad) ≤ grindingTermPoW P
